Game Overview

Shuttledeck puts players into a strategy experience centered on command your space fleet in Shuttledeck, a strategic deck-builder set in a galaxy of conflict. Customize your deck with ships, crew, and tech to execute tactical plays. Engage in thrilling, ever-changing battles and missions, aligning with factions or challenging them in this endlessly replayable sci-fi adventure.
